description.purpose: The container this organisation's members are instantiated into. It ships empty and open: no cells, no ports, no contract of its own. Its whole job is to be an address that already exists, so the mutation that instantiates a member has somewhere to put one.
description.use_when: Never on its own -- it travels with org@1.0.0. Address it as <org>/members in the add_nodes of the mutation that instantiates a member, and draw that member's own edges in the same mutation.
description.not_in_scope: No ports, because a sealed hive refuses exactly the endpoints a member instantiation needs (hive_port_boundary). No contract, because a lane declared here would have no door until the first member exists, and a contracted hive with no door refuses every later mutation in the colony. No cells: what stands in this container is a member, and a member is instantiated, never shipped.
